name: omega-hub
description: Sovereign MCP hub for the Omega tri-token economy — SOV accounting, USE contribution receipts, CARE stewardship, AMITY exchange entitlements, and OMEGA macro-governance.

tools.name: sov_mint
tools.description: Mint SOV to an address (simulated ledger).

tools.name: sov_burn
tools.description: Burn SOV from an address.

tools.name: sov_transfer
tools.description: Transfer SOV between addresses.

tools.name: sov_snapshot
tools.description: Current SOV balances, supply, and ledger version.

tools.name: use_issue
tools.description: Issue a proof-of-useful-work receipt (non-transferable by default).

tools.name: use_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a USE receipt by ID with a reason.

tools.name: use_snapshot
tools.description: All USE receipts and attestation counts.

tools.name: care_submit
tools.description: Submit a Proof-of-Care claim in proposed state.

tools.name: care_attest
tools.description: Attest a CARE claim; two independent attestations move it to final.

tools.name: care_appeal
tools.description: File an appeal on a finalized or attested CARE claim.

tools.name: care_snapshot
tools.description: CARE claims, attestation counts, and open appeals.

tools.name: amity_entitle
tools.description: Convert a finalized CARE claim into an eligible AMITY entitlement under a published policy.

tools.name: amity_transfer
tools.description: Transfer AMITY between addresses.

tools.name: amity_snapshot
tools.description: AMITY balances, supply, and entitlements.

tools.name: omega_mint
tools.description: Mint OMEGA to an address with a reason and protocol version.

tools.name: omega_lock
tools.description: Lock OMEGA for a duration in blocks; returns a governance weight.

tools.name: omega_proposal
tools.description: Draft a governance proposal with change set, simulation reference, and rollback plan.

tools.name: omega_vote
tools.description: Vote on a proposal by voter, support flag, and weight.

tools.name: omega_snapshot
tools.description: OMEGA balances, supply, locks, and proposals.

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Full deterministic ledger snapshot across all planes plus event count.

tools.name: events_since
tools.description: All events after a given version for replay.

tools.name: full_event_log
tools.description: Complete append-only event log.
